values: cpa with pre-trained gene embeddings | loaded pre-trained cpa model encoded gene expression into basal state combined with learnable embeddings of drug dose and covariates used gene embeddings from pre-defined models to predict expression changes.

components.name: method
values: grn inference with genecompass embeddings | gene-gene similarity computed via cosine similarity of genecompass embeddings converted to binary adjacency matrix with threshold 0.4 used to update deepsem grn output. evaluated by auprc against chip-seq ground truth.

components.name: task
values: compared with geneformer scgpt embeddings and vanilla deepsem using auprc metric on chip-seq-based ground truth.
used gene embeddings from genecompass to generate gene-gene relationship adjacency matrix threshold 0.4 and updated deepsem grn output.

components.name: method
values: genecompass pre-training | 12-layer transformer l=12 h=12 d=768 with gelu activation dropout 0.02 layer-norm epsilon 1e-12. pre-trained with batch size 10 learning rate linear decay with 10 000 warm-up steps max lr 5e-5 adamw optimizer for 3 epochs on 4x8 nvidia a800 gpus. input top 2048 genes per cell after ranking by expression concatenated absolute expression value and gene id plus species token. four prior knowledge types promoter grn gene family co-expression encoded into unified embedding space. masked language modeling 15% of genes masked multi-task loss l = 1-β l_id + βl_exp β hyperparameter .

components.name: result_metric
values: number of cells used for pre-training
number of homologous genes in token dictionary

components.name: task
values: constructed sccompass-126m corpus of over 120 million human and mouse single-cell transcriptomes after preprocessing 101 768 420 cells retained.
input top 2048 ranked genes per cell with concatenated absolute expression values and gene ids plus species token. output 768-dimension gene and cell embeddings.
integrated four types of prior biological knowledge promoter sequences gene co-expression networks gene family information and transcription factor-target gene regulatory relationships.
pre-trained genecompass on 101.76 million cells using a 12-layer transformer with 768 hidden size 12 attention heads and over 100 million parameters.
used masked language modeling strategy masking 15% of gene inputs per cell with multi-task learning to predict both gene id cross-entropy loss and expression value mse loss .

components.name: method
values: immunostaining and differentiation of tf-overexpressing cells | hescs cultured on matrigel in mtesr plus lentiviral overexpression of nr5a1 or gata4 long-term cultivation in α-mem with ksr 2-mercaptoethanol penicillin/streptomycin immunofluorescence staining for gonadal markers.

in silico quantitative perturbation | for in silico overexpression target gene expression value is increased to a specified level. for in silico knockout target gene expression is reduced to zero half or quarter. after manipulation single-cell transcriptome is re-ranked and cell embedding is obtained from genecompass. effect measured by cosine similarity between post-perturbation and ground-truth cell embeddings.

simulated ipsc induction by in silico overexpression of oskm genes at low and high levels in human and mouse fibroblasts.
validated top candidate genes nr5a1 and gata4 by lentiviral overexpression in hescs and performing immunofluorescence and transcriptome analysis.
